story_type: offshore oil platform on fire, helicopter hoists two workers
hook: An oil platform caught fire fifty miles out in the Gulf.
narration: This oil platform caught fire fifty miles south of Grand Isle, Louisiana.
Black smoke poured off it, and the Coast Guard sent aircraft and boats.
On a Dolphin helicopter, the flight mechanic runs the hoist and talks the pilot into position.
Then two men from the platform came up in the rescue basket.
outcome: The Air Station New Orleans crew hoisted both men into the helicopter.

location_card.place: Gulf of Mexico, off Grand Isle, La.

title: Oil platform on fire 50 miles out
description:
On March 6, 2011, a Coast Guard MH-65C crew from Air Station New Orleans hoisted two men who were on board the GI 102A oil production platform when it caught fire about 50 miles south of Grand Isle, Louisiana.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station New Orleans, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/109120/coast-guard-rescues-2-after-platform-fire
